title: SkiFree Racers...decompile experiment gone crazy
author: nodesandedges
selftext:
This game won't blow your socks off, but I thought it was a fun diversion from my everyday data science work: [https://skifree-racers.chromekitsune.workers.dev](https://skifree-racers.chromekitsune.workers.dev)

  
It started as an experiment to test out some of Claude's decompiler skills. I pointed REA at the Win32 binary for SkiFree (early Windows game). The game is simple, so it served well as a first experiment. REA decompiled it easily, and then I one shot it to translate it to a web-browser version (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, only). 

  
Then...I don't know what happened. I started adding more features, goofing around, and playing around with game development with Claude Code, which isn't something I've done before until now. Very cool. The changes post-decompile were not a one shot. I actually built out a specifications document, identified features, went through discovery, and implemented in batches, play testing along the way. I also built code to simulate runs for unit, regression, and end to end testing. 

  
Anyway, have fun!
